authority: display + read-only feed — a fixed direction rule over stored calendar rows; no engine reads this, it gates nothing, it predicts nothing

feed_actuals.note: 3 USD rows stored and not one carries an actual: the ForexFactory this-week JSON has no actual field. Actuals come from FRED and from the next release's 'previous', both labelled

fred.note: no FRED pull has run on this box yet — the sweeper pulls every 6 h; `python -m scripts.macro_pull` runs one by hand

coverage.note: a monthly indicator releases once a month and the feed posts one week at a time, so a low percentage early in a cycle is expected; it fills as the weeks accumulate

direction_rule: Bullish = the latest reading moved in the USD-positive direction versus the previous one for THAT indicator (higher payrolls, CPI, ISM …; lower unemployment, claims); Neutral = unchanged; UNKNOWN = not released or not parseable. Counted, never weighted.
